## Où j'en suis
The PostgreSQL 17 blue/green Terraform changes are prepared for staging, with AWS pinned to v5.82 and a staging plan showing 1 addition and 1 change; production is prepared but disabled, with no plan changes. Nothing was applied. A draft PR is open, and pg_partman and production scheduling remain outstanding.

- [en-cours] PR #57 is open; changes are prepared but not yet applied.
- [prochaine-étape] Upgrade pg_partman to 5.x on staging and verify maintenance for `events_raw` and `events_daily`; then revisit the staging upgrade.
- [prochaine-étape] Get Maya’s sign-off before choosing a production window; avoid the 01:00–03:30 UTC dbt lock.
- [essai-raté] Initial `terraform init` failed because the lock file pinned AWS 5.31.0; provider v6 was rejected due to unrelated plan changes, so AWS was pinned to 5.82.
- [essai-raté] Initial TFLint run flagged an unused variable and missing `random` provider constraint; both were fixed, and TFLint passed.
